in_marathi.name: Tridip
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tridip हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Tridip is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Tridhā' which means 'three steps'. It is a name of Lord Vishnu and is believed to bring prosperity and success.
